original_value: Intel 660p Series M.2 NVMe SSD 1TB. Description: Meet today’s storage needs and prepare for the growing demands of tomorrow with the Intel SSD 660p Series built on Intel QLC 3D NAND technology. The Intel SSD 660p is the first QLC-based client PCIe SSD in the industry, continuing Intel’s leadership in flash cell technology and quality manufacturing, featuring a 1TB capacity and sequential read/write speeds of 1,800MB/s. The SSD 660p finally fits low-cost and high-capacity into one drive.

Description: Built on Intel QLC 3D NAND technology, the Intel SSD 660p helps meet current storage requirements while getting ready for tomorrow’s expanding demands. As the industry’s first QLC-based client PCIe SSD, it continues Intel’s leadership in flash cell technology and quality manufacturing, with 1TB capacity and sequential read/write speeds of 1,800MB/s. The SSD 660p brings low cost and high capacity together in a single drive.
